text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! I finish exquisitely once
again!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do not lament so, my dear Vodka! You
fell to
none other than me, an
insurmountable foe.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
From the start, my running was not only

impeccable—it was flawless. Compound
that with
my Overlord Training and...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Here I stand! Having climbed another
level,
having reached a new height of
excellence!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, for it was crafted by my
trainer
specifically for me.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Keenly designed to account for my
unique
physique, it allows my radiance
to grow brighter
by the day!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! I guess a good training regimen really does makes the difference!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be so cool to get that kind of
advice
from your very own trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Just so... Thus, so have your own abilities

improved tenfold through your daily
devotion to
me, Trainer.
choice_data_list: 努力あってのものだけどな
努力あってのものだけどね
choice_data_list_en: Though that's all thanks to your hard work.
Though that's all thanks to your hard work, of course.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am the driving force of not only my
own growth,
but of my trainer's as well!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hark! Behold the awe-inspiring wonder
that is I!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't feel like a compliment, but I
suppose
that's T.M. Opera O's way of
saying she likes my
training methods.
